rationale.intuition: Grinnell overall ~12.68%, ED1 ~40.8% (combined ED count is high — small applicant pool), ED2 ~18% per Scarlet & Black 2024 reporting. Intl-CN penalty materially compresses pool (intl ~5-8% RD baseline at Grinnell, no published intl ED2 rate). Strong math profile fits Grinnell's quantitative culture; ED2 boost partially offsets intl penalty. Counselor consensus 8-22%. Lower bound caps at the intersection of intl-CN baseline + ED2-only-pool effect; upper bound stops below the published 18% because intl applicants typically see less ED2 lift than domestic.

sources.name: Grinnell CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 12.68%; ED1 admit rate 40.8%; CDS C21 reports separable ED I and ED II rounds with ED2 admit count materially smaller than ED1.

sources.name: Scarlet & Black (Grinnell student paper) — 2024 ED2 coverage
sources.evidence: Reported Grinnell ED2 admit rate ~18% for Class of 2028, with ED2 application volume roughly half of ED1 and lower yield.

sources.name: Crimson Asia Acceptance Report 2024
sources.evidence: Strong intl-CN applicants at T20 LACs cluster 8-15% in RD and 12-25% with binding ED commitment when academic fit is strong.

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024 §4.2
sources.evidence: ED gives 2-3× lift at T20 LACs but lift narrows for intl pools due to need-aware policy at LACs (Grinnell is need-aware for intl).

wontFixReason: Engine over-predicts Grinnell ED2 + intl-CN combo (31.70% vs industry [8, 25]). Suspected double-application of intl-multiplier × ED2-boost at small LACs. Tier B follow-up: cap intl + round boost stacking at 1.5×.
